spots.ticket_reason: No single steward; island with several resorts.
spots.bio: Yasawa island beside the Blue Lagoon, with a walk over the island, snorkelling in a fish sanctuary and a dive shop.
spots.notes: Island itself has no gate; no fee found. Resorts/dive shop charge separately.

spots.ticket_reason: No official site for the island; only a resort listed.
spots.bio: Small Yasawa island where a climb to the top gives sunrise views and a walk crosses a spit to Waya.
spots.notes: Wikivoyage calls the island Wayalailai in the Yasawa guide; no Wikipedia article (Waya_Lailai and Wayasewa both missing). Draft's 'three-hour walk to Naboro' not found in sources, dropped. Guides available per Wikivoyage; no price.

spots.bio: Fiji's first national park, with 20-60 m dunes at the Sigatoka River mouth, two walking trails and Lapita archaeology.
spots.notes: Adults $10 (intl students $7, local students 6-17 $5) on the National Trust of Fiji page (title 'Sigatoka Sand Dunes | National Trust of Fiji'). Own gate fee, not a pass; no Fiji park pass known. fiji.travel page BLOCKED (403).

spots.ticket_reason: Public beach, no steward found (resort area).
spots.bio: White-sand beach on the Coral Coast with shade trees, considered one of Fiji's best and good for horse riding.
spots.notes: No Wikipedia article. Wikivoyage lists no fee; access fee on the beach unverified.

spots.ticket_reason: Island with several resorts and villages; no single steward.
spots.bio: Island 10 km south of Viti Levu with nine villages, five noted for fire-walking, and a few resorts.
spots.notes: Wikipedia names five fire-walking villages (Dakuibeqa, Dakuni, Soliyaga, Naceva, Rukua) and four resorts. Boat access from Pacific Harbour not in fetched sources.

spots.ticket_reason: Place dived by operators; spot is the reef, not one operator (Beqa Adventure Divers is the original: https://www.fijisharkdive.com/).
spots.bio: Marine reserve off Beqa where divers meet up to eight shark species, including bull sharks, on a two-tank dive.
spots.notes: FJ$500 = two-tank Shark Dive, plus FJ$25/day reserve levy and FJ$20 fuel surcharge (rates 1 Apr 2026-31 Mar 2027, one operator's price; levy not added). Snorkel FJ$100. Operator departs Pacific Harbour (Pacific Harbour Wikivoyage listing).
